$sources: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3 (design for fatigue): Sec 3.1 (general), Sec 3.3 (plain material and welded joints, Eqs A-3-1M, A-3-2M), Table A-3.1 (the fatigue design parameters by section and stress category)
source: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3: the stress categories' Cf and threshold FTH of Table A-3.1, the design stress range of Sec 3.3 in SI form; the numbers equal the default pack's (BNBC 2020 Sec 10.17 is AISC based)

default.source: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.3, Eq A-3-1M: FSR = (Cf × 329 / nSR)^0.333 >= FTH, stress categories A, B, B', C, D, E, E'

F.source: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.3, Eq A-3-2M: FSR = (Cf × 110 000 / nSR)^0.167 >= FTH, stress category F

E.source: AISC 360-22 Table A-3.1 Sections 2.4, 3.4, 3.5 (flange up to 20 mm), 8.3

E'.source: AISC 360-22 Table A-3.1 Sections 3.5 (flange over 20 mm), 3.6, 4.1 (t over 20 mm)

sources.minCycles: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.1: no evaluation of fatigue resistance below 20 000 cycles of the live load
sources.maxServiceStress: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.1: the maximum stress due to unfactored loads at most 0.66 Fy
sources.threshold: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.1: no evaluation when the live load stress range is below FTH
sources.cycles: AISC 360-22 Appendix 3, Sec 3.3: nSR = the stress range fluctuations in the design life (per day × 365 × years)
